description: Establishment of the Gambling Regulatory Authority
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-04-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to establish the Gambling Regulatory Authority to function as the sole independent regulator with a broad and overarching scope on operations in the gambling industry in Sri Lanka including online and off‑shore gambling activities on ships and in the Colombo Port City. Clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the Bill prepared as per the approval granted by the Cabinet on 2025‑02‑24 to prepare a Bill for the same. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to publish the Gambling Regulatory Authority Bill in the Government Gazette and submit the same thereafter, to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Renovation of the Karainagar Boatyard, owned by Cey-Nor Foundation Limited
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-04-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - During the official visit made by the Hon. President in India in the month of December 2024, a Memorandum of Understanding was signed to obtain a Grant from the Government of India to renovate the Karainagar Boatyard. In terms of the said Memorandum of Understanding, the Government of Sri Lanka has been charged with the responsibility of securing technical consultancy services for the project and for exempting taxes on the goods and equipment relevant to the said Grant. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Fisheries, Aquatic and Ocean Resources to obtain the service of the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau as the Consultant of the Project and to allocate Rs. 40 million from the General Treasury for expenses to be incurred by the Government of Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding of contract for Ground Handling Services of SriLankan Airlines Limited at Melbourne Airport in Australia
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-04-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The existing contract for the provision of ground handling services at the Melbourne Airport, Australia is due to expire on 2025‑06‑30. Therefore, limited international competitive bids have been invited to select a ground handling service provider for the next 03 years. The Standing High Level Procurement Committee, after reviewing four (04) bids received for the same has recommended that the relevant contract be awarded to Dnata Airport Services Pty Limited. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to award the contract for the provision of ground handling services (Passenger, Ramp and Cargo Warehouse handling) for SriLankan Airlines at Melbourne Airport, to the said company at a total estimated cost of AUD 13,124,402, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Increasing the grant provided for a Housing Unit under "Obata Geyak - Ratata Hetak" Housing Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-04-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - "Obata Geyak - Ratata Hetak" Housing Programme is implemented with the objective of reducing the housing problem and related poverty among poor or low income earners. Under the said programme, a poor or low income family in each Grama Niladhari Division is identified on priority basis and a grant would be provided to construct/improve a house based on the progress of construction. The selected beneficiary should construct a house at least with 550 square feet and in addition to the Rs.650,000/- which is provided by the Government for the same, the balance amount has to be borne by the relevant beneficiary. At the commencement of the programme, the estimated cost of a house was Rs.1,147,000/-, but as of now, the said cost has increased up to Rs.1,764,000/-. Since the selected beneficiaries are not in a position to bear the balance amount in addition to the Government grant as per their economic condition, the proposal made by the Minister of Urban Development, Construction and Housing to increase the Government grant of Rs.650,000/- being paid for a housing unit at present up to Rs.1,000,000/-, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Promoting tourism and passenger transportation activities using 	waterways under Public-Private Partnership
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-04-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Since Sri Lanka is an island blessed with water sources and waterways, it is possible to utilize those water sources and waterways for promotion of the tourism industry as well as urban passenger transportation. Therefore, attention has been focused on starting a boat service covering several areas using the country's coastal waters as well as the inland waterways. Accordingly, it is expected to facilitate tourism promotion and passenger transportation by establishing a marine transport service as Puttalam - Fort, Fort - Galle, Galle - Matara, etc. and establish required infrastructure facilities for the purpose. Similarly, it is expected to promote the tourism industry by providing inland water transportation facilities using potentials such as Hamilton Canal, Beira Lake, Diyawanna Oya and Madu Ganga. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism to conduct a feasibility study on the implementation of the relevant project and to implement the proposed project as a Public-Private Partnership programme, based on its outcome, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of the Report on Annual Economic Review of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka for the year 2024
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-04-07 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - In terms of section 80(3) of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka Act, No. 16 of 2023 the Minister in-charge of the subject of Finance should submit a Report on the status of economy prevailed during the financial year within a period of four-month at the end of each financial year, to Parliament. Accordingly, the Report on Economic Review of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka for the year 2024 prepared by the Central Bank of Sri Lanka has been submitted to the President. The said Report provides a review of the macroeconomic trends in Sri Lanka, the status and the key developments of the financial system and the policies of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to present the Report on Annual Economic Review of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka for the year 2024, to Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Recruitment of 30,000 graduates and youths to fill in essential vacancies in the Public Service
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-04-07 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The policy of the present Government is to make recruitments for the Public Sector, based solely on qualifications and merits without any political influence. Taking into consideration the rapid increase in the number of unemployed graduates and youths due to the recent economic and political instability and the Covid 19 pandemic, and also the existing fiscal space, approval of Parliament has been granted for the budget proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to allocate a provision of Rs.10 billion from the Budget 2025 to fill 30,000 essential vacancies in the Public Service. An Officials' Committee has been appointed under the Chairmanship of the Secretary to the Prime Minister to re-review the cadre of various institutions in the Public Service and submit recommendations for making essential recruitments. The approval of the Cabinet has been granted for 18,853 new recruitments in the Public Service as of now, based on the recommendations made by the said Committee. Accordingly, the Cabinet, taking into account a proposal made by the Minister of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government, has decided that the relevant Ministries should take measures expeditiously to make the said recruitments by calling for applications in accordance with the prescribed Scheme of Recruitment under the "Programme to recruit 30,000 unemployed graduates and youths to the Public Service proposed in the Budget 2025".

description: Amendment to the National Archives Act No.48 of 1973
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-04-07 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2022.11.21 to appoint a Committee of Experts comprising of competent persons on the subjects of document management, document preservation and digitized document management to submit appropriate recommendations to amend the National Archives Act, No.48 of 1973. The said Committee of Experts, having considered the comments of the public and other consultations, has drafted a National Policy on Archives and Records Management. Further, an initial draft has also been prepared to use as a basis in the preparation of the National Archives and Records Management Bill by repealing the National Archives Act No.48 of 1973 and the National Archives (Amendment) Act, No. 30 of 1981. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minster of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs to approve the National Policy on Archives and Records Management prepared by the Committee of Experts and to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a Bill to introduce the National Archives and Records Management Bill by repealing the  National Archives Act No. 48 of 1973 and the National Archives (Amendment) Act No.30 of 1981, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Community Based Corrections Act, No.46 of 1999
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-04-07 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2024.01.24 to amend the Community Based Corrections Act, No.46 of 1999. The Attorney General has submitted several amendment proposals for the Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman, accordingly. The proposal made by the Minister of Justice and National Integration to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare the final Bill to amend the Community Based Corrections Bill incorporating the said proposed amendments as well, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Bill to establish the Chartered Institute of Media Professionals of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-04-07 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The need to establish the Chartered Institute of Media Professionals of Sri Lanka has been identified to meet the necessity of a training institute required to carry out the relevant studies with the aim of producing chartered media professionals and to produce a group of competent  and knowledgeable media professionals to enhance the quality and standard of the media community in the country. Accordingly, approval of the Cabinet has been granted at its meeting held on 2022.08.15 to prepare a Bill enabling to establish the said Institute through an Act passed by Parliament. The proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to grant policy approval of the present Government to finalize the preparation of the said Bill, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amending the National Minimum Wage of Workers Act, No.3 of  2016
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-04-07 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- The 2025 Budget proposals have proposed to increase the wages of private sector employees in parallel with the salary increase of public sector employees. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Labour to revise the National Minimum Monthly Wage and the National Minimum Daily Wage as mentioned below and to follow other relevant legal measures related thereto,was approved by the Cabinet:

	*	to increase the National Minimum Monthly Wage by 	Rs.9,500 from Rs.17,500 to Rs.27,000, with effect from	2025.04.01.

	*	to increase the National Minimum Daily Wage by 	Rs.380 from 	Rs.700 to Rs.1,080, with effect from 	2025.04.01.

	*	to increase the National Minimum Monthly Wage by 	Rs.3,000 from Rs.27,000 to Rs.30,000, with effect from	2026.01.01.

	*	to increase the National Minimum Daily Wage by Rs.120 from 	Rs.1,080 to Rs.1,200, with effect from 2026.01.01.

description: Obtaining approval of the new Cabinet for the Bill for the Protection of New Plant Variety Rights
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-04-07 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Although, the Intellectual Property Act, No.36 of 2003 provides legal provisions related to copyright, industrial designs, patent rights, brands and business names, etc., there are no provisions for the protection of plant variety rights (pertaining to breeders, researchers and farmers). Further, according to the provisions of the Intellectual Property Act, patent rights cannot be granted for plants and animals. Therefore, approval has been granted to introduce a new Act for the protection of new plant variety rights at the Cabinet meeting held on 2024-05-22. Accordingly, the Legal Draftsman has pointed out that policy approval of the present Cabinet has to be obtained to finalize the preparation of the Bill for the protection of new plant variety rights. The proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation to grant the approval of the Cabinet to finalize the said Bill, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of the Gazette Notifications for the approval of Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-04-07 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to submit the following Regulation/Orders published through the Government Gazette, for approval of Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

*	Regulation made on the revision of the Luxury Tax Threshold on Motor vehicles under the Finance Act, No.35 of 2018, published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No. 2421/41 dated 2025-01-31.

*	Order made under the Excise (Special Provisions) Act, No.13 of 1989, pertaining to the revision of the Excise Duty Rates on electric vehicles, published by the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No. 2421/42 dated 2025-01-31.

*	Order made under the Finance Act, No.35 of 2018, pertaining to the extension of the concessionary period granted under the Embarkation Levy	published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2421/30 dated 2025-01-31.

description: Procurement for the supply of 70,000 vials of 5g-6g Human 	Immunoglobulin for Intravenous use
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-04-07 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - International Competitive Bids have been invited to procure 70,000 vials of 5g-6g Human Immunoglobulin for intravenous use, which is used to treat the patients with immune deficiencies. Six (06) bids have been received for the purpose. The proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to award the relevant procurement to M/s Reliance Life Sciences (Pvt) Ltd., India, the substantially responsive lowest evaluated bidder for a sum of USD 6.86 million, based on the recommendation of the Standing High-Level Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the supply of 3 million inactivated doses of Rabies Vaccine (Human Use) in 0.5ml/1 ml
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-04-07 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - International Competitive Bids have been invited under the procurement for the supply of 3 million inactivated doses of Rabies Vaccine in 0.5ml/1 ml used to treat for the prevention of Rabies. 05 bids have been received for the same. The proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to award the relevant procurement to M/s Gulf Pharma (Pvt) Ltd., Sri Lanka, (Manufacturer: M/s Chiron Behring Vaccine (Pvt) Ltd, India), the lowest evaluated substantially responsive bidder, based on the recommendation of the Standing High Level Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement process for the purchase of Pre-Printed Polycarbonate 	Cards for the issuance of National Identity Cards
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-04-07 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Department for Registration of Persons has commenced using Smart Cards for the issuance of National Identity Cards in the year 2017. Under the new method introduced by the Electronic National Identity Card (e-NIC) project to be implemented in the future, an electronic National Identity Card has to be issued to all Sri Lankan citizens who have completed 15 years of age. It has been identified that there is a need of around 17 million cards to re-register Sri Lankan citizens and issue a new identity card. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Digital Economy to purchase 15 million Polycarbonate Cards, following the international competitive bidding method, to meet the said requirement, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding the contract for the purchase of 05 shipments of  Gasoline 92 Unl during the period from 2025 04 15 to 2025 10 14
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-04-07 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Bids have been invited form the registered suppliers of the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation to purchase 05 shipments of Gasoline 92 Unl 300,000+/-5% each for a period of six(06) months from 2025.04.15 to 2025.10.14. Seven (07) suppliers have submitted bids for the purpose. The proposal made by the Minister of Energy, to award the said procurement to M/s Vitol Asia Pte.Ltd., Singapore, the substantially responsive lowest evaluated bidder, based on the recommendations of the Standing Technical Evaluation Committee and the Special Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Selection of investors for the development of lands belonging to the Urban Development Authority
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-04-07 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- The Cabinet has decided previously that the formal Procurement Procedure should be followed to select suitable investors when setting apart lands belonging to the Urban Development Authority on  long-term lease basis for the implementation of development projects. Accordingly, the proposals made by the Minister of Urban Development, Construction and Housing to follow the Procurement Procedures to select suitable investors to set apart the following plots of land, which have been transferred to the Urban Development Authority under section 6(1) of the State Land Ordinance, on long-term lease basis, adhering to the Planning Regulations of the Urban Development Authority, based on the valuation of the Government Valuer:

* 	to set apart 03 plots of land with an extent of 42.03 Perches, 20.28 Perches and 20.72 Perches respectively, which can be further set apart after allocating lands required for the proposed urban development out of the lands acquired for the Sellakataragama urban development 	activities, on 50-year long-term lease basis.

* 	to set apart the plot of land with an extent of 03 Acres, 2 Roods, 24.59		Perches from the land located in Dematagoda (537 Watta), on 99-year long-term lease basis.

description: Submission of the Report on the Deviation of Headline Inflation from the Inflation Target set out in the Monetary Policy Framework Agreement during the Third and Fourth Quarters of 2024  to Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-04-07 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - In accordance with the Monetary Policy Framework Agreement signed between the Hon. Minister of Finance and the Central Bank of Sri Lanka on 2023 10 03 under section 26(1) of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka Act No. 16 of 2023,  the Central Bank of Sri Lanka has been charged with the responsibility of maintaining the quarterly  headline inflation measured by the Colombo Consumer Price Index (CCPI) compiled by the Department of Census and Statistics, at the rate of 5%. As per section 26(5) of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka Act No. 16 of 2023, in case the Central Bank of Sri Lanka fails to meet the said inflation targets from margin specified for two consecutive quarters, the Monetary Board of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka is required to submit a Report in that regard to Parliament through the Minister in charge of the subject of Finance. Likewise the General Public shall have access to the same. Average of the quarterly headline inflation based on the Colombo Consumer Price Index, has been recorded as 0.8% and -1.5% during the third and fourth quarters in the year 2024 respectively and it remains below 2% less than the inflation target for consecutive two quarters. As such, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to table the  Report on the Deviation of Headline Inflation Target submitted to the Minister in charge of the subject of Finance under section 26(5) of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing of a Tripartite Memorandum of Understanding among 	the South Asian Centre for Teacher Development (SACTD), 	UNESCO South Asia Regional Office (SARO) and Indira Gandhi 	National Open University (IGNOU)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-04-07 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The South Asian Centre for Teacher Development has been established as an autonomous and self-financed institution. The UNESCO Executive Board has recommended that the functions of the said Centre should be upgraded to promote its work and establish partnerships with other institutions and organizations in the region. Accordingly, it has been proposed to sign a Tripartite Agreement among the South Asian Centre for Teacher Development, the UNESCO South Asia Regional Office and the Indira Gandhi National Open University aiming to introduce a new high quality training programme on Media and Information Literacy thereby further developing regional cooperation and strengthening national and regional action plans, including the targets outlined in the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development. The clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the proposed draft MoU. The approval of the Cabinet was granted for the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education to sign the said Tripartite Memorandum of Understanding.

description: Providing relief to the people affected by the earthquake in Myanmar
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-04-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- The people of Myanmar have been severely affected due to the strong earthquake that occurred on 2025-03-28 and international media have reported that about 2,700 people have died so far. It has been further reported that a large number of people are missing and another large number of people are undergoing treatment in hospitals due to injuries caused by the above incident. Taking into consideration the long-standing close relationship between the people of the two countries as two Buddhist States, the Cabinet decided to grant the following contribution of the Sri Lankan people to provide relief for the people of Myanmar:

*	 to provide a financial assistance of one million US dollars.

* 	To take necessary steps to promptly provide the material aid collected under the leadership of the Buddhist monks in this country, to the people of Myanmar, with the intervention of the Government.

* 	To keep in readiness a Relief Team consisting of the doctors and other health staff members to be sent to Myanmar, whenever necessary.

description: UK Sanctions on four Sri Lankans
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-04-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- The attention of the Cabinet was drawn to the recent decision taken by the United Kingdom to impose sanctions on 04 Sri Lankans. The Cabinet decided to appoint a Ministerial Committee with the following composition to examine the above matter and submit a Report with recommendations to the Cabinet on the future action to be taken and to authorize the Committee to co-opt the servìces of any other officer/expert with expertise in the relevant subject matter deemed necessary for its deliberations:

*	Hon. Vijitha Herath
  Minister of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism

*	Hon. Harshana Nanayakkara (Attorney-at-law)
  Minister of Justice and National Integration

*	Hon. Aruna Jayasekara
  Deputy Minister of Defence

description: Submission of the revised Welfare Benefits Payment Scheme for approval of Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-04-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025-03-17 to revise the Aswesuma Welfare Benefits Payment Scheme by increasing the values ​​of the benefits paid as of now, under the above Scheme. Accordingly, the revised Aswesuma Welfare Benefits Payment Scheme had been published by the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No. 2429/02 dated 2025-03-24. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to submit the said revised Aswesuma Welfare Benefits Payment Scheme to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment to the Post of Director of the Department of Cultural      Affairs
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-04-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The post of Director of the Department of Cultural Affairs is currently vacant. Mrs. K.S. Dilhani, Grade I officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, who is serving as a Senior Assistant Secretary of the Ministry of Defence, has been found suitable to be appointed to the said post. Taking into consideration the proposal made by the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs accordingly, the Cabinet decided to appoint Mrs. K.S. Dilhani, to the post of Director of the Department of Cultural Affairs.

description: Appointment to a Post of Additional Secretary of the Prime Minister's   Office
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-04-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Five (05) posts of Additional Secretary of the Special Grade of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service have been approved for the Prime Minister's Office, of which three (03) are currently vacant. Mr. A.B.M. Ashraff, Special Grade Officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, currently serving as a Management Specialist for the Green Climate Fund of the United Nations Development Programme for Sri Lanka, has been identified as suitable to be appointed to a said vacant post of Additional Secretary.  Considering the proposal submitted by the Hon. Prime Minister accordingly, Cabinet decided to appoint him as an Additional Secretary in the Prime Minister's Office, with immediate effect.

description: Revisiting the existing Electricity Act No.36 of 2024
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-04-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - An Expert Committee has been appointed by the Secretary to the Ministry of Energy with the approval of the Cabinet to obtain appropriate recommendations for amending the Electricity Act No. 36 of 2024. The said Committee has taken measures to seek the views of the key stakeholders of the power sector. Accordingly, actions have been taken to conduct knowledge sharing sessions and obtain written views and proposals and thus, 59 stakeholders have submitted their written views and proposals. In addition, views have been obtained from development partners who provide funds for development projects in the power sector as well as from other parties interested in restructuring the power sector. Taking into account the said views and proposals, the Expert Committee has submitted its final Report containing the proposed amendments to the Electricity Act No. 36 of 2024. The proposal made by the Minister of Energy to prepare a Bill to amend the Electricity Act, based on the recommendations in the said Report, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the supply of 18,000 Vials of Trastuzumab Injection 440mg in 20 ml  Vials (with solvent)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-04-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - International Competitive Bids have been invited for the purchase of 18,000 Vials of Trastuzumab Injection 440mg in 20 ml Vials used to treat certain types of cancers. Four bids have been submitted for the same. The proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to award the procurement for the supply of 18,000 Vials of Trastuzumab Injection 440mg in 20 ml Vials (with solvent), to M/s. Cliniqon Biotech (Pvt) Ltd., (Manufacturer: AryoGen Pharmed, Iran), the lowest evaluated substantially responsive bidder, based on the recommendation of the Standing High-Level Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Surgical Gauze required for the Medical 	Supplies Division for the year 2025
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-04-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Based on the Government’s policy of uplifting local small scale manufacturers, surgical gauze required for the Government hospitals is purchased from local manufacturers under a regular ration scheme. The requirement of surgical gauze for the Medical Supplies Division for the year 2025 has been estimated as 30 million meters. The Surgical Gauze Ration Determination Committee has recommended to purchase 30 million meters of surgical gauze for the year 2025 from 282 registered local manufacturers. The Pricing Committee has approved the fixed price of one meter of surgical gauze so purchased as Rs 68.97. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to purchase 30 million meters of surgical gauze for the year 2025 from 282 registered local manufacturers of the Medical Supplies Division at the said fixed price, based on the recommendation of the Standing High Level Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the supply of 150,000 vials of 1,000,000 IU Vial Colistimethate Sodium for injection
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-04-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - International competitive bids have been invited for the purchase of 150,000 vials of Colistimethate Sodium Injection in 1,000,000 IU, which is an antibiotic used to treat serious infections caused by certain gram-negative bacteria. 03 bids have been received for the purpose. The proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to award the relevant procurement to M/s Slim Pharmaceuticals (Pvt) Ltd., of Sri Lanka (Manufacturer: M/s Gufic Biosciences Ltd, India), the lowest evaluated substantially responsive bidder, based on the recommendation of the Standing High Level Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the supply of 340,000 Bottles of Human Albumin Solution 20% in 50ml Bottle
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-04-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - International Competitive Bids have been invited for the supply of 340,000 bottles of Human Albumin Solution 20% in 50ml Bottles, used to treat low blood volume (hypovolemia) and low albumin levels in blood. Two bidders have submitted bids for the same. The proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to award the relevant procurement to M/s Reliance Life Science (Pvt) Ltd., India, the lowest evaluated substantially responsive bidder, based on the recommendation of the Standing High-Level Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Regional Office of the Department of Immigration and Immigration in the Jaffna District
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-04-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - A Regional Office of the Department of Immigration and Emigration is currently established in the Vavuniya District in the Northern Province which includes the largest number of Districts in Sri Lanka. People living in Jaffna, Kilinochchi and Mullaitivu Districts have to spend a considerable period of time in traveling to the Vavuniya Regional Office of the Department of Immigration and Emigration to seek the immigration and emigration related services. At the Jaffna District Coordination Committee meeting chaired by the Hon. President, held on 2025‑01‑31, it has been proposed to establish a Regional Office of the Department of Immigration and Emigration in the Jaffna District as well to provide an expeditious service to the people living in the Northern Province since a large number of them have applied for passports. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Public Security and Parliamentary Affairs to establish the proposed Jaffna Regional Office of the Department of Immigration and Emigration on the premises of the District Secretariat, Jaffna, in this month, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Revision of Salaries of the Public Service - 2025
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-03-24 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- The Cabinet considered the proposals submitted by the Hon. President in his capacity as Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development and the Minister of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government, regarding the issuance of Circular instructions including provisions for the payment of salaries according to the revised salary scales, to be effective from 2025.04.01 based on the proposal submitted by the Hon. President to revise the salaries of the Public Service through the Budget 2025 and decided as follows:

*	To authorize the Secretary, Ministry of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government to issue Circular instructions to all Secretaries to the Ministries, Chief Secretaries of Provinces and Heads of Departments pertaining to the revision of salaries of the Public Service.

*	to authorize the Secretary of the Ministry of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to issue Circular instructions to State Corporations, Statutory Boards and Fully State-owned Companies and other relevant institutions.

description: Implementation of the “Seasonal Food Package” Distribution Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-03-24 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - In keeping with the proposal made by the Hon. President under the Budget 2025 to provide a package of essential food commodities at a concessionary price during the Sinhala and Tamil New Year season, it has been planned to provide a "Seasonal Food Package" containing essential food commodities worth Rs.5,000 at a concessionary price of Rs.2,500. For this purpose, it is expected to select suitable beneficiaries from among the 812,753 applicants who have submitted new applications expecting Aswesuma benefits. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation and the Minister of Trade, Commerce, Food Security and Cooperative Development to take necessary steps to provide the food package to the beneficiaries through the Lanka Sathosa outlet network and COOPFED outlets located throughout the country from 2025-04-01 to 2025-04-13, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment of the Tower Hall Theatre Foundation Act, No.01 of 1978
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-03-24 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2023-03-21 to amend the Tower Hall Theatre Foundation Act, No.01 of 1978. Accordingly, the Legal Draftsman has informed that the Bill prepared as such should receive the concurrence of the present Cabinet of Ministers. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs to grant policy approval to amend the Tower Hall Theatre Foundation Act No. 01 of 1978, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment of the Companies Act, No.7 of 2007
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-03-24 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The approval of the Cabinet has been granted to amend the Companies Act, No.7 of 2007 to address the deficiencies relating to the transparency of beneficial ownership of legal persons in line with international standards to curb Money Laundering, Financing of Terrorists and other unlawful activities. Accordingly, the Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman has been further amended as per the advice given by the Attorney General based on the Supreme Court Special judgment bearing No.SC/SD/92/2024. Accordingly, the clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the final Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman. The proposal made by the Minister of Trade, Commerce, Food Security and Cooperative Development to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter, submit the same to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of Regulations imposed under the Regulation of Fertilizer Act, No.68 of 1988 for approval of Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-03-24 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The fees payable for obtaining a license to import, manufacture or formulate fertilizer under the Regulation of Fertilizer Act, No.68 of 1988 have been published through the Regulations published in the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No. 1683/5 dated 2010 12 06. The approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2024 02 05 to periodically revise the fees published by the said Regulations. Accordingly, the Regulations prepared by the Legal Draftsman, have been published in the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No. 2398/13 dated 2024 08 20. The proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation to submit the said Regulations to Parliament for approval in accordance with the provisions of the Regulation of Fertilizer Act, No. 68 of 1988, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amending the Land Acquisition Act, No.9 of 1950
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-03-24 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Owing to the long time taken in following the provisions of the Land Acquisition Act No.9 of 1950, which is currently in force, approval of the Cabinet has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2021 01 11 to amend the said Act to suit to the present day requirements, so that the time taken for the land acquisition procedure could be reduced, lands can be acquired under a simple procedure and compensation could be paid under a uniform methodology. The initial draft for the purpose has been prepared and the Legal Draftsman has informed that the policy approval of the Cabinet need to be obtained to finalize the preparation of the said Bill. Accordingly, taking into account the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation, the Cabinet decided to instruct the Legal Draftsman to expeditiously prepare the said Bill.

description: Repeal of Foreign Loan Act, No.29 of 1957 and its subsequent amendments
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-03-24 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Since the Public Debt Management Act No. 33 of 2024 covers the procedures to be followed for managing foreign borrowings, the Foreign Loan Act No.29 of 1957 and all the amendments made thereto need to be repealed. Policy concurrence of the Cabinet has been granted for the purpose at its meeting held on 2024 12 09. Clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the Foreign Debt (Repeal) Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter submit the same to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the supply of Lubricants for the Sapugaskanda Power Station
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-03-24 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Bids have been invited from the suppliers recommended by the Original Equipment Manufacturer as specified in the Operation and Maintenance Manual to award the contract for the supply of lubricants for SEMT Pielstick PC 4.2 Diesel Engines (Plant A) and MAN B&W 8L Diesel Engines (Plant B) installed at the Sapugaskanda  Power Station, from March 2025 to February 2026. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Energy to award the contract for the supply of 414,000 liters of lubricants for the Plant A to Lanka IOC PLC, and to award the contract for the supply of 389,000 liters of lubricants for the Plant B to Chevron Lubricants Lanka PLC., was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Reactivation of the Co operative Wholesale Establishment
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-03-24 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The then Cabinet, at its' meeting held on 2024 09 02, has decided to repeal the Co operative Wholesale Establishment Act No. 47 of 1949 and liquidate the said Establishment. However, the Co-operative Wholesale Establishment has the potential to play a crucial role in implementing the role of the Government in market operations with the objective of ensuring the continuous supply of quality goods and service to the general public at reasonable prices by promoting market competition in keeping with the policy framework of 'A Thriving Nation; A Beautiful Life',  Therefore, the proposal made by the Minister of Trade, Commerce, Food Security and Co-operative Development to rescind the previous  Cabinet decision pertaining to the liquidation of the Co-operative Wholesale Establishment and resume its' business activities based on a viable business plan, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: ASEAN Sectoral Dialogue Partnership (SDP)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-03-24 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) is a political and economic union of 10 countries in Southeast Asia. It includes some of the fastest growing economies in the world and these countries contribute approximately 6.5% of the global GDP. Sri Lanka currently maintains diplomatic relations with all ASEAN member countries, however, it is also observed that a strong relationship with ASEAN is essential for shared economic progress. Although it is not possible for non-Southeast Asian countries to get the membership of ASEAN, the ASEAN can confer the status of "Sectoral Dialogue Partner" to an external country based on its ability to contribute to the objectives of the ASEAN. Eventhough Sri Lanka has submitted a Letter of Intent for Sectoral Dialogue Partnership and a proposal to achieve the objectives at ASEAN in 2019 to the ASEAN Secretariat, no further action has been taken in that regard. Therefore, the proposal made by the Minister of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism to submit a new work/activity plan by Sri Lanka with clear time lines pertaining to the Letter of Intent submitted in 2019 following the process outlined by ASEAN for an external party to obtain the status of an "ASEAN Sectoral Dialogue Partner", was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Anti-Corruption Action Plan 2025 - 2029
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-03-24 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Anti-Corruption Act, No.9 of 2023 has broadened the role of the Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption from investigation of bribery and corruption-related offenses and prosecution to the implementation and regulation of anti-corruption policies to eliminate bribery and corruption across country. As the Government's "Clean Sri Lanka" programme strives to elevate the Sri Lankan society to a higher level of ethical development, the need to formulate and implement a robust national anti corruption policy including all sectors has been identified. Further, as specified in the United Nations Convention Against Corruption, an Anti Corruption Framework needs to be prepared and implemented. Moreover, a robust Anti-Corruption Framework has to be implemented to meet certain global commitments. In line with the obligations under Article 5 of the United Nations Convention Against Corruption, Sri Lanka's first National Action Plan against Bribery or Corruption has been implemented during the period 2019-2023. Reviewing the said Action Plan, a new National Anti Corruption Action Plan for the period 2025-2029 has been prepared with the participation of local and international stakeholders. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President to implement the National Anti-Corruption Action Plan - 2025 -2029 in collaboration with the Ministries, Departments, all Government Institutions and other relevant stakeholders, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Regulations under section 156 of the Anti-Corruption Act, No.9 of 2023
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-03-17 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - In terms of section 156(1) of the Anti Corruption Act, No.9 of 2023, the Minister in-charge of the subject of Justice is vested with the power to consult the Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption and make regulations pertaining to specific matters stipulated under the said Act. In view of section 82(1) of the aforesaid Act, every person to whom the aforesaid part applies shall, in the form as prescribed by regulations make declarations of assets and liabilities. "Assets and liabilities" means assets, liabilities, income, expenditure and interests directly or beneficially owned in or outside of Sri Lanka, the details of which shall be prescribed by regulations. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice and National Integration to publish the Anti Corruption (Declaration of Assets and Liabilities) Regulations 2025, made in accordance with the provisions of the Anti Corruption Act, No.9 of 2023, in the Gazette and thereafter to present the said regulations in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment to the Post of Commissioner General of Labour
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-03-17 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Mr. H.K.K.A. Jayasundara, presently serving as the Commissioner General of Labour of the Department of Labour, has requested to be released from the Post of Commissioner General of Labour enabling him to serve in some other Post, as he has completed approximately a service period of 23 years in the said Department. Therefore, the proposal made by the Minister of Labour to attach him to the Ministry of Public Administration, Provincial Councils, and Local Government, enabling to be appointed to some other suitable post and to appoint Mrs. H.M.D.N.K. Wataliyadda, Special Grade Officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, to the Post of Commissioner General of Labour which falls vacant accordingly, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment to the Post of Commissioner General of Inland Revenue
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-03-17 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Mrs. W.A.S. Chandrasekara, who served as the Commissioner General of Inland Revenue, has retired from the Public Service from 2025 02 28. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to appoint with immediate effect, Mrs. R.P.H. Fernando, Special Grade Officer of the Inland Revenue Service, presently serving as a Deputy Commissioner General of the Department of Inland Revenue, to the Post of Commissioner General of Inland Revenue which has fallen vacant, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of the Gazette Notifications published under the Revenue Protection Act, No.19 of 1962 and the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) for approval of Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-03-17 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- Approval of the Cabinet has been received at the Cabinet meeting held on 2024 12-09 to impose a Customs Import Duty of 30% on the import of motor vehicles in parallel with the lifting of the temporary suspension on the importation of such vehicles. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to submit the following Orders published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notifications, to Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet:

* 	Revenue Protection Order No. 01/2025 under section 2 of the Revenue Protection Act No. 19 of 1962 published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No. 2421/05 dated 2025.01.27.

* 	Order made under section 10(A) of the Customs Ordinance, (Chapter 235), published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No. 2421/43 dated 2025.01.31.

description: Repealing the Sri Lanka Accounting and Auditing Standards Act, No.15 of 1995, and Finalizing the Draft Financial Reporting Regulatory Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-03-17 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2021 05 24 to repeal the Sri Lanka Accounting and Auditing Standards Act No. 15 of 1995 and introduce a new Act. Accordingly, the Legal Draftsman has prepared the initial draft of the Financial Reporting Regulatory Bill, after obtaining the views of the Sri Lanka Accounting and Auditing Standards Monitoring Board and other relevant stakeholders. The Legal Draftsman has pointed out that the policy approval of the new Cabinet should be obtained to finalize the preparation of the said Bill. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to grant the concurrence of the Cabinet for the preparation of the said Bill, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of the amendments to the Personal Data Protection Act, No.9 of 2022
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-03-17 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025 02 19 to amend the Personal Data Protection Act, No.9 of 2022. Clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the amending Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman for the purpose. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Digital Economy, to publish the Personal Data Protection (Amendment) Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter, submit the said Bill to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Project Implementation Consultants under the Power System Strengthening and Renewable Energy Integration Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-03-17 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Asian Development Bank has agreed to provide funds under the "Power System Strengthening and Renewable Energy Integration Project" to implement several transmission development and distribution projects for strengthening and modernization of the electricity distribution network operated by Lanka Electricity Company (Private) Limited., due to the increase in electricity demand in the areas where the company operates. The following activities have been identified to be carried out under the said project: * 	Obtaining a power injection from the Ceylon Electricity Board through a grid substation in the Kelaniya area.* 	Introducing a 33 kV power injection to strengthen the medium voltage network of Lanka Electricity Company (Private) Limited., in the areas of Kelaniya/Negombo and Kotte/Negombo. * 	Converting the identified areas in Kelaniya and Kotte/Nugegoda to underground cable networks.  * 	Implementation of the 11 kV automated feeder reconfiguration project in the branch areas of Kotte, Nugegoda, Moratuwa and Kalutara.  * Implementation of the Supervisory Controll and Data Acquisition System & the Network Automation System Accordingly, the recommendation submitted by the Minister of Energy to initiate the procurement process to select suitable Consultants to implement the said project activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the supply of 6,000 Vials of 40mg Tenecteplase Injection
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-03-17 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Bids have been invited for the purchase of 6000 vials of 40mg Tenecteplase vaccine, which is used to prevent death of people with heart attacks, following the International Competitive Bidding procedure. 03 bids have been received for the purpose. The proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to award the relevant contract to M/s Lifecerll Interventions (Pvt) Ltd., of Sri Lanka (Manufacturer - Gennova Biopharmaceuticals Limited, India), the substantially responsive lowest evaluated bidder, based on the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of Phase II of the Project for the Supply of High-quality Radiotherapy Equipment with High-Power Radiations
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-03-17 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Elekta UK Limited, United Kingdom and the Ministry of Health have entered into an Agreement in 2013, to supply 14 Linear Accelerators in two phases to be used for cancer care services. Accordingly, under Phase I of the said Project, 09 machines have been installed so far, as 04 Linear Accelerators at the National Cancer Institute, 02 machines at the National Hospital, Kandy, 01 machine at the National Hospital, Galle, 01 machine at the Teaching Hospital, Batticaloa and 01 machine at the Base Hospital, Thellipalai, Jaffna. The recommendations forwarded by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to install the technologically advanced Infinity Linear Accelerators in 05 hospitals in Ratnapura, Badulla, Hambantota, Anuradhapura and Kurunegala under Phase II of the Project and take steps to construct bunkers in the relevant hospitals to enable the installation of these machines, taking into consideration the proposals submitted by the Sri Lanka College of Oncologists as well, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing Financial Fertilizer Subsidy to farmers cultivating in paddy lands for the Yala season 2025
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-03-17 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- Taking into consideration a proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation, the Cabinet has decided to grant approval for the provision of financial fertilizer subsidy to farmers cultivating paddy in paddy lands and to farmers cultivating other field crops in paddy lands in the Yala season 2025, as follows:

* 	Rs. 25,000 per hectare for paddy cultivation in paddy lands in the Yala season 2025, up to a maximum of 02 hectares.

* 	Rs. 15,000 per hectare for cultivation of other field crops on paddy lands as decided at the Kanna meetings, up to a maximum of 02 hectares.

description: Terms of Reference for the National Tariff Policy Committee
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-03-17 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has previously granted approval to introduce and implement a National Tariff Policy aiming at a transparent and affordable tariff system with the objective of creating a competitive market within the Asian region and transforming Sri Lanka into an investment destination. However, neither the appointment of a National Tariff Policy Committee for that purpose nor the determination of functions of the said Committee has been made. The proposed Terms of Reference for the National Tariff Policy Committee have been formulated by the Ministry of Finance, Planning and Economic Development. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development for the said Terms of Reference and for the appointment of the National Tariff Policy Committee headed by a Deputy Secretary to the Treasury, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Revising the Aswesuma Welfare Benefits Payment Scheme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-03-17 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
The Aswesuma Welfare Benefits Payment Scheme, being implemented from 2023-07-01, has been last revised through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2415/66 dated 2024-12-21. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to revise the benefits provided under the Aswesuma Welfare Benefits Payment Scheme, which is currently in force, within the provisions allocated through the Budget Estimates of the year 2025, as follows and publish the same through a Gazette Notification, was approved by the Cabinet.

*	Extension of the time period during which the Transitional Social Segment contained in Schedule I of the Aswesuma Welfare Benefits Payment Scheme receives benefits, up to 2025.04.30.

*	Increase of the monthly allowance granted to persons with disabilities and that granted to patients with chronic kidney disease of unknown etiology (CKDU) included in Schedule II of the said Scheme, from Rs.7,500 to Rs.10,000 and increase of the monthly allowance granted for elderly citizens from Rs.3,000 to Rs.5,000 and implementing the said decision with effect from April 2025.

*	Extension of payment period of the allowance for persons with disabilities, the allowance for the patients with chronic kidney disease of unknown etiology (CKDU) and the allowance for the elderly citizens, up to 2025 12 31, subject to the above proposals.

*	Extension of the payment period of benefit allowances granted to persons with disabilities, patients with kidney diseases and elderly persons in such families, up to 2025 12 31, although the payment of allowance under the Transitional Social Segment ceases after April 2025, .

*	Inclusion of newly received applications from the persons with disabilities and patients with kidney diseases, subject to the maximum limit of such applications, and payment of the relevant allowances to the eligible persons up to 2025.12.31.

description: Establishment of Firefighting Units and upgrading of equipment in Export Processing Zones of the Board of Investment of Sri Lanka under the Economic and Social Development Programme of the Government of Japan
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-03-17 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been identified that the establishment of in-house firefighting units with modern fire fighting equipment in Export Processing Zones operating under the Board of Investment of Sri Lanka could build confidence among investors and minimize damage by protecting employees and properties of industries through immediate responses. For that purpose, the Japanese Government has agreed to provide 4 firefighting vehicles with a capacity of 4000 liters each and 12 sets of equipment for Katunayake, Biyagama, Seethawaka and Wathupitiwala Export Processing Zones through a Grant of Japanese Yen 300 million (approximately 590 million Rupees) under the Economic and Social Development Programme of the Government of Japan. The coordination and implementation of this Project is to be carried out by the Board of Investment of Sri Lanka with the technical collaboration of the Fire Department of the Colombo Municipal Council. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to sign the relevant Exchange of Notes and other documents to obtain the proposed Grant, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of the Review Report on State-owned Non-Commercial Entities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-03-17 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It had been decided at the Cabinet meeting held on 2024-12-18 to appoint an Officials' Committee under the Chairmanship of the Secretary to the Prime Minister to review and submit a Report on State-owned Non-Commercial Institutions. The Committee has reviewed 160 institutions and has decided to seek the assistance of a sub-committee comprising of the members from the field to review 36 higher education institutions out of these, including universities. The recommendations of the Committee have been submitted by classifying the remaining 124 institutions other than the said institutions under 09 categories. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister to implement the said recommendations, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment to the post of District Secretary/Government Agent of the Administrative District of Kurunegala
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-03-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Since Mr. R.M.R.Rathnayake, who served as the District Secretary/Government Agent of the Administrative District of Kurunegala, has retired from the public service on 2025‑03‑03, the said post has become vacant. Mr. D.M.K.C. Dissanayake, Special Grade Officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, who is currently serving as the Secretary to the Provincial Chief Ministry of the North Western Province, has been identified as a suitable Officer for the said post. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government to appoint Mr. D.M.K.C. Dissanayake as the District Secretary/Government Agent of the Administrative District of Kurunegala, with immediate effect, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment to the Post of District Secretary/Government Agent in the 	Administrative District of Kegalle
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-03-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Since Mr. J.M.R.P. Jayasinghe, who served as the District Secretary/Government Agent in the Administrative District of Kegalle, has been appointed to the Post of Chief Secretary of the North Central Province with effect from 2025‑02‑01, the Post of District Secretary/Government Agent, Kegalle has fallen vacant by now. It has been identified that it would be appropriate to appoint Mr. H.M.J.M. Herath, Special Grade Officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, presently serving in a Post of Additional Secretary of the Ministry of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government, to the said Post.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government to appoint Mr. H.M.J.M. Herath, Special Grade Officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, to the Post of District Secretary/Government Agent in the Administrative District of Kegalle with immediate effect, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Tea Control Act, No.51 of 1957
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-03-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)

description: Amendment to the Industrial Promotion Act No.46 of 1990
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-03-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been observed that the provisions of the existing Industrial Promotion Act No. 46 of 1990 are inadequate for the formulation of industrial policies to meet the timely requirements in the industry sector in relation to the fields of technology, trade, skills and environment etc. Therefore, approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2021‑03‑08 to amend the said Act. The Legal Draftsman is making amendments to the said Act at present and the need of obtaining policy concurrence of the present Cabinet for amending the said Act has been pointed out by the Legal Draftsman. Accordingly, taking into consideration the proposal made by the Minister of Industry and Entrepreneurship Development, it was decided to grant policy approval of the Cabinet to expedite the preparation of the said Bill.

description: Payment of annual contributions to the International Solar Alliance (ISA) and signing of the Country Partnership Framework (CPF) between Sri Lanka and ISA
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-03-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- The International Solar Alliance has been established with the aim of supporting the member nations pathway to promote the use of solar energy. At present, 75 countries, including Sri Lanka, have become its members and 54 countries have ratified the Partnership Framework Agreement. Sri Lanka is required to pay a voluntary contribution of US$ 25,000 annually based on the category to which it belongs. As a member State, Sri Lanka has the opportunity to accrue benefits such as capacity building relating to solar energy sector through Solar Technology Application Resource Centres (STAR-C), Policy Development, Access to Funding, Global Networking, Knowledge Exchange, from the International Solar Alliance. Accordingly, the following proposals made by the Minister of Energy, were approved by the Cabinet:

*	to continue the payment of an annual contribution of US$ 25,000 from the financial year 2024/25 onwards.

*	to establish a Solar Technology Application Resource Centre (STAR-C) in Sri Lanka.

*	to sign the 'Country Partnership Framework' between Sri Lanka and the International Solar Alliance.

description: Construction of a Lawyers' Office Complex acquired adjacent to the New Galle Courts Complex
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-03-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- Proposal pertaining to the construction of a Lawyers' Office Complex at the expense of the Galle Bar Association on a plot of land in extent of 130 perches adjacent to the New Galle Courts Complex acquired for the use of the Ministry in charge of the subject of Justice, was taken up for discussion at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025‑02‑03. At this meeting, an Officials' Committee headed by the Secretary, Ministry of Justice and National Integration, comprising of representatives from the Ministry of Finance Planning and Economic Development, Land Commissioner General's Department including other relevant institutions, has been appointed to examine the existing legal and other matters pertaining to the implementation of the said proposal and submit a Report with recommendations to the Cabinet. The proposal made by the Minister of Justice and National Integration to sign a Memorandum of Understanding between the Ministry of Justice and National Integration and the Galle Bar Association to pursue action as follows, based on the recommendations submitted by the said Officials' Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

*	Construction of a Lawyers' Office Complex through the funds of the Galle Bar Association on the above plot of land in extent of 130 perches, having the ownership of the land with the Government.

*	Handing over the tenure of the said building to the Galle Bar Association to use the same for a period of 30 years, attending to its maintenance, in a manner that the total amount invested by the said Association for the construction of the building is covered by the lease rental.

*	Not to use the building for any commercial purpose other than providing servìces to the public in relation to the legal profession.

*	Handover of the tenure of the building to the Ministry in charge of the subject of Justice after a period of 30 years.

*	If the said building is further required thereafter, to provide the opportunity to use the said building, having entered into a fresh Memorandum of Understanding with the Galle Bar Association, based on the valuation of the Chief Government Valuer.

description: Legal status regarding changing the design and modification of buses
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-03-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - In keeping with the Regulations issued under the provisions of the Motor Traffic Act, changes in the design of vehicles and their modifications could be made with the prior approval of the Commissioner General of Motor Traffic. Accordingly, by amending the Motor Traffic (Construction of Vehicles) Regulations published in 1983, from time to time, Regulations regarding the manner in which such modifications can be made, have been published through Gazette Notifications. In addition to the installation of vehicle accessories and changes in the design published through such Regulations in the past, the Department of Motor Traffic has also prepared a set of guidelines for decoration of buses and modification of components through different internal procedures and an internal circular too has been issued thereon. However, no Regulations related thereto have been published in accordance with the provisions of the Motor Traffic Act. Therefore, Cabinet decided to grant its concurrence for the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways, Ports and Civil Aviation to appoint a Committee representing the Ministry of Transport, Highways, Ports and Civil Aviation including other relevant parties, to examine the possible impact of bus decorations and accessories on the safety of passengers travelling in buses, taking all these circumstances into account and submit a Report with recommendations for taking appropriate measures in this regard.

description: Acceptance of the Manifesto 'A Thriving Nation - A Beautiful Life ' as the National Policy Framework of the Government
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-03-03 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- The manifesto ' A Thriving Nation - A Beautiful Life ' has been put forward with a view to attaining sustainable economic growth and development through a robust production economy with a target of reaching a real Gross Domestic Production of US$ 120 billion by 2030. It has been structured under four main sectors stated below encompassing all sectors including economic, social, environmental, political:

*	A fulfilling life - A comfortable country

*	An honorable life - A safer country

*	A modern life - A wealthy nation

*	A dignified life - A strong country

	Forty (40) sub-sectors have been identified under those 04 main sectors, and the policy principles and actions to be taken pertaining to the said areas have been identified separately. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to accept the manifesto "A Thriving Nation - A Beautiful Life" as the National Policy Framework of the Government and to direct the Ministries, Departments, State Institutions, Provincial Councils and Local Authorities to plan and implement their functions accordingly, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment to the Post of Director General of the Disaster Management Centre
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-03-03 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The contract period of service of retired Major General, H.M.U. Herath presently serving in the Post of Director General of the Disaster Management Centre is due to expire on 2025‑03‑07. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Defence, to appoint retired Major General Sampath Kotuwegoda for a period of one (01) year on contract basis, to the Post of Director General of the Disaster Management Centre, which falls vacant from the said date, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Ratification of UNESCO (2005) Convention on the Protection and Promotion of the Diversity of Cultural Expressions by Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-03-03 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - UNESCO has adopted a Convention on the Protection and Promotion of the Diversity of Cultural Expressions created in its Member States on 2005‑10‑20, which has come into force on 2007-03-10. The Convention has been ratified by 156 Member States as of now. Although the approval of the Cabinet at its meeting held on 2024‑09‑09, has been granted to ratify the said Convention by Sri Lanka, it has not yet been ratified. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs seeking policy approval to ratify the UNESCO (2005) Convention on the Protection and Promotion of the Diversity of Cultural Expressions by Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Legislation Programme of the Government
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-03-03 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- The proposal made by the Minister of Urban Development, Construction and Housing to incorporate the following new laws and amendments to the existing laws to be introduced by the Ministry of Urban Development, Construction and Housing in the year 2025, to the Legislation Programme of the Government - 2025, was approved by the Cabinet.
